eid_r.declaration: KAPSO's native evaluator identity: EID_r = manifest_fingerprint(kapso_evaluation/) over the two-file registered tree this adapter installs (execution/evaluation_integrity.py:112-119, maintainer.py:216-218). a0_locator.json carries EID*'s EvaluatorSource records and canonical theta_E; kapso_eval.py re-hashes E*'s sources on every invocation and exits 3 without a score on any mismatch, so EID_r cannot be produced by a different E*.

registered_tree.fingerprint_rule: KAPSO's own: sha256(json.dumps(manifest, sort_keys=True, separators=(',',':'))) — execution/evaluation_integrity.py:112-119
registered_tree.mapping: EID_r = manifest_fingerprint({kapso_eval.py, a0_locator.json}); a0_locator.json carries the EID* component digests, the E* source records and the canonical theta_E that kapso_eval.py enforces at run time, so recomputing EID_r requires only EID* and this adapter's two source files.
